name: Natural★Petit
source:
A fandisc with promo materials for Natural 2 game and lots of information on original Natural game: wallpapers, system voice collection, capture hints, heroines library room and staff corner.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
這張粉絲向附加盤收錄了《Natural 2》的宣傳素材，以及大量關於初代《Natural》的內容，包括桌布、系統語音集、攻略提示、女主角資料室和製作人員專欄。

［摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/12/vn-of-month-march-2000.html]vndbreview[/url]］
